user.title: Kid Chores & Points
user.description: Create a points tracker (one per child). Chores, rewards and the weekly goal are configured afterwards via **Configure** on the integration.

abort.already_configured: A tracker with this name already exists.

init.title: Chores & Points
init.description: Changes are saved as you go. Pick **Finish** when done.

settings.title: Goal, policy & currency

data.goal_bonus: Goal bonus (extra points when the goal is reached)
data.missed_goal_policy: If the weekly goal is missed
data.week_breakdown: Per-chore breakdown in the weekly summary

settings.description: The week closes at 23:59 on the day before the first day of the week. Then the week's points move to the bank, depending on whether the goal was reached.

data_description.week_start: The week closes at 23:59 on the day before this day (Monday = closes Sunday night).
data_description.weekly_goal: Mandatory points needed in one week to reach the goal (bonus-chore points don't count). Reaching it means points this week ≥ the goal.
data_description.goal_bonus: A flat extra amount added to the bank when the week closes with the goal reached, on top of the points earned and the week's bonus points. Example: goal 50, bonus 10, earned 55 → 65 go to the bank (plus any bonus-chore points). Set 0 for no bonus. Never paid when the goal is missed.
data_description.missed_goal_policy: What gets banked if the goal is NOT reached: all of the week's mandatory points, half of them (rounded down), or none. No goal bonus is paid and the week's bonus-chore points are lost either way.
data_description.currency: Shown after wallet amounts, e.g. kr. Only a label – no conversion.
data_description.history_limit: How many changes are kept in the points history (the History card and the Points history sensor). When the limit is reached the oldest entries are dropped. Lowering it trims the history at the next change. Between 50 and 1000.
data_description.week_breakdown: Add how many times each chore was done to the parents' weekly summary notification.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Select the **person** for the child and the parents; their phones (Home Assistant Companion app) are found automatically. The `notify` service fields below are optional extras (e.g. a tablet or group). The child person is also used to decide whose chore completions count: if the child has a linked Home Assistant user, completions made by other users are ignored (completions without a user still count).

data.notify_kid: Extra notify services for the child
data.notify_parents: Extra notify services for the parents

data_description.language_kid: Automatic uses the language set in the child's own Home Assistant profile (the person's user), or the system language if there is none. Choose a language to always use that one.
data_description.language_parents: Automatic uses the language set in the parents' own profiles when they all agree, otherwise the system language.

mandatory.title: Mandatory chores

mandatory_add.title: Add mandatory chore
mandatory_add.description: Pick a task from Maintenance Supporter (or type a name, which then matches on the task name). Remember to give the task the label `mandatory` in Maintenance Supporter if you want it in the dashboard list. To change an existing chore, use Edit a chore.

bonus.title: Bonus chores

bonus_add.title: Add bonus chore
bonus_add.description: Pick a task from Maintenance Supporter (or type a name, which then matches on the task name). Remember to give the task the label `bonus` in Maintenance Supporter if you want it in the dashboard list. To change an existing chore, use Edit a chore.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.description:
Name the reward for ONE unit (e.g. `15 min Xbox`) and its cost in points. A reward can also pay money into the child's wallet instead of being handed out.

{items}

data_description.payout: Leave at 0 for a normal reward. Set e.g. 5 to turn it into a cash-out: each unit costs the points above and adds this much ({currency}) to the wallet. Example: 10 points → 5 {currency}.

data_description.name: Change the name to rename the reward.
data_description.payout: 0 = a normal reward that is handed out. Above 0 = a cash-out: each unit costs the points above and adds this much ({currency}) to the wallet.

mandatory_edit_item.title: Edit mandatory chore
mandatory_edit_item.description: Change the points, or pick another task / type another name to rename the chore. A chore picked from the list stays linked to its task, so renaming the task in Maintenance Supporter doesn't break it. A name you type matches on the task name only.

bonus_edit_item.title: Edit bonus chore
bonus_edit_item.description: Change the points, or pick another task / type another name to rename the chore. A chore picked from the list stays linked to its task, so renaming the task in Maintenance Supporter doesn't break it. A name you type matches on the task name only.

bedtime.title: Bedtime reminder
bedtime.description: Set the child's bedtime to send a reminder to the child's device if mandatory chores are still open. Leave both times empty for no reminder. The notification goes to the child's phone and extra notify services (see Notifications).

data.bedtime_lead: Remind this many minutes before bedtime

data_description.bedtime: The bedtime on school nights. The reminder is sent only if some mandatory chores are not done yet.
data_description.bedtime_weekend: Bedtime on Fridays and Saturdays. Optional; leave empty to use the school-night bedtime every night.

medals.title: Streaks & medals
medals.description: Streaks and medals for the child. A **day streak** counts days in a row when every mandatory chore is done, a **week streak** counts weeks in a row when the weekly goal is reached. Medals can also count chores and bonus chores. A medal can pay bonus points (at most 50) straight into the bank. Counting starts when you switch it on.

data.medals_grace: Forgive one missed day per week
data.medals_notify: Notify when a medal is earned

data_description.medals_enabled: Counting starts when you turn this on; earlier chores don't count. Turning it off pauses counting and hides the medals but keeps what was earned.
data_description.medals_grace: A day streak survives one missed day in each week. The missed day isn't counted.
data_description.medals_notify: Send a notification to the child and the parents when a medal is earned.

medals_day.title: Day-streak medals
medals_day.description: Set how far the child has to get for each medal and how many bonus points it pays (0–50, added to the bank). Each target must be higher than the one above. Medals that are already earned stay earned.

data.day_3_at: Little Sprout: days in a row
data.day_7_at: Super Seven: days in a row
data.day_14_at: Hot Streak: days in a row

medals_week.title: Week-streak medals
medals_week.description: Set how far the child has to get for each medal and how many bonus points it pays (0–50, added to the bank). Each target must be higher than the one above. Medals that are already earned stay earned.

data.week_16_at: Top of the World: weeks in a row
data.week_16_bonus: Top of the World: bonus points
data.week_20_at: Mega Champ: weeks in a row

medals_chores.title: Chores-done medals
medals_chores.description: Set how far the child has to get for each medal and how many bonus points it pays (0–50, added to the bank). Each target must be higher than the one above. Medals that are already earned stay earned.

medals_bonus.title: Bonus-chore medals
medals_bonus.description: Set how far the child has to get for each medal and how many bonus points it pays (0–50, added to the bank). Each target must be higher than the one above. Medals that are already earned stay earned.

error.name_exists: An item with this name already exists. Use Edit to change it.
error.lead_too_long: The reminder would fall before midnight. Use a shorter time or a later bedtime.
error.medal_order: Each medal needs a higher target than the one above it.
